summary: Backend testing for Voice Home Client backend (FastAPI + JWT + MongoDB). Wrote pytest suite covering auth, admin seeding, RBAC, user CRUD, settings CRUD (with URL normalization), static device catalog (19 devices), and proxy/status endpoint shape. 22/22 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login uses username.strip().lower() — usernames are case-insensitive/normalized, good. Test data used lowercase to align.

CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=False — fine since auth uses Bearer tokens in headers (not cookies). If cookies are later required, this needs explicit origins with credentials=True.
No brute-force lockout / rate-limiting on /api/auth/login — acceptable for a local PWA but worth noting.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes password if admin exists but password differs (idempotent).
bcrypt hash generation via bcrypt.hashpw with gensalt() — produces $2b$ hashes as expected.
get_current_user also falls back to cookies['access_token'] — cookies aren't set by the login endpoint, so this is dead code but harmless.

PATCH /api/users/{id}: uses find_one_and_update with return_document=True — this returns the ORIGINAL doc in pymongo unless ReturnDocument.AFTER is used. Test still passed because the update propagates via a subsequent GET-effectively, but actually since ObjectId converts and update happens synchronously, the returned doc reflected updated values in our test — likely because motor's find_one_and_update with return_document=True defaults to AFTER. Consider using pymongo.ReturnDocument.AFTER explicitly for clarity.
server.py is 441 lines — within acceptable size, but proxy handlers duplicate the same try/except _forward pattern; could be extracted to a helper.
No validation on allowed_pages values in user create/update (accepts arbitrary strings). Consider validating against a known set.
seed_data_creation: Tests create/delete ephemeral users (username prefix 'test_<uuid>') and clean up after each test. Global setting temporarily updated then restored to http://127.0.0.1:3000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (22/22). Proxy endpoints that talk to the Node.js server (devices/control/shopping-list/parse-*/tts/audio) were intentionally NOT tested end-to-end because the Node server is not running in this container — only /api/proxy/status was verified (correctly returns online=false when node server unreachable). Frontend testing not requested in this iteration. When testing frontend, use external URL from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and admin credentials from test_credentials.md.
